🌍 Flag facts
🐉
The flag is called Y Ddraig Goch, which means "the Red Dragon" in Welsh.
🌿
The white and green were the colours of the Tudors, a royal family with Welsh roots.
📜
The Red Dragon was officially recognised as the national flag of Wales in 1959.
🇬🇧
Wales does not appear on the Union Jack, because it was already joined to England when the first Union Flag was made.
